title: 宝塚記念の後に・わらう？

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Telling Tosen Jordan that there's nothing cooler than being the greatest dummy seems to help her run with all her might.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her enthusiasm spreads to Nakayama Festa, who declares she's aiming to take on the world, and encourages Jordan to attempt a feat only she can pull off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thinking on what kind of feat would qualify, Jordan realizes that to be the greatest means to run faster than any legend in the history books.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hearing her new goal, I suggest the autumn Tenno Sho as the place to make it a reality. Fired up already, she challenges Gold Ship to join too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, Gold Ship refuses, claiming it's not her race to run. The fall Tenno belongs to Jordan.
